page.layout: One page of text, single column at the top; below it a signature line "O 3" and a catchword-like mark "E" at right; a woodcut ornament below the text. No margin notes.

main_text.l: aurei limbi compleverant. Postquam paululum inam-
bulasset flexis genibus una cum Episcopo orationem
Dominicam recitavit, tertio eandem repetens, & sub fi-
nem adiunxit elata voce in manus tuas Domine com-
mendo spiritum meum. Abiecto deinde pallio & toga,
junctisque manibus ad Deum tota mente conversus,
carnificem expectavit, qui uno ictu caput illud amputa-
vit, quod pro Regis obsequio, tot tantisque periculis
sese obiectarat. Cadaver eius sanguisque nigro panno tectus est.

page.notes: The first word "aurei" is printed with a long-s-like form and read as "aurei"; the line-initial word "aurei" may be a broken word from the previous page. The text reads "inambulasset" and "conversus" as printed; the signature "O 3" and the mark at right "E" are in the lower margin area. The ornament is a woodcut and is not transcribed.
